summary: Collective Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K reporting the effectiveness of its S-1 registration and the consummation of its initial public offering of 22,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit for gross proceeds of $220 million, each unit consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one-half warrant. This is a routine IPO closing, not a special situation such as a de-SPAC business combination or a Going-Private transaction. The underwriters have a 45-day over-allotment option. No special-situation event is present.
